subject: Greenstone evaluation readiness & parity acceptance
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood-inference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@greenstone-payments.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Greenstone discovery — next steps for eval

Hi Maria — great speaking with you today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery so we can scope a short benchmark-driven trial: 

What you told us (short):
- Primary use: agent-assisted chargeback triage and merchant support summarization (sensitive PII redaction required).
- Volume: ~12M texts/month; median request length ~120 tokens, tail to 1k tokens for transcripts.
- SLA target: p95 latency <350ms for single-turn generation in production.
- Key risk: hallucinations on dispute contexts and missing merchant-specific policies.

Recommended evaluation plan (two-week trial):
1) Model candidates: open models + our proprietary baseline to assess parity and regression risk
   - Open candidates: Llama3-8B-ql (8B quantized), Falcon-40B-instruct (fp16), and Mistral-instruct-7B.
   - Proprietary baseline: PropBase-v1 (your current internal comparator).
2) Benchmarks & prompts: we suggest running the attached prompt bundle (greenstone_prompt_bundle_v1.csv) across:
   - Intent classification (dispute category), extraction (merchant, amount), and free-text summarization accuracy
   - Hallucination probe prompts (rare / adversarial merchant cases)
3) Acceptance criteria (parity gates):
   - Summaries: ROUGE-1 F1 >= 0.88 vs. PropBase-v1 on held-out set
   - Extraction (entities): token-F1 >= 0.92
   - Hallucination: false-positive factual assertions <3% on adversarial set
   - Latency: p95 < 350ms for trimmed context (with Redwood autoscaling/batching)
   - Regression tolerance: any >3 percentage-point drop on primary metric triggers automatic rollback to PropBase-v1 for that route

Operational guardrails we propose to enable: automatic canaries (5% traffic), continuous regression monitoring tied to prompt bundles, and a deterministic fallback route to PropBase-v1 if quality or latency SLOs are breached. See the sample benchmark summary attached (benchmark_summary_sample.pdf) and our eval playbook (redwood_eval_playbook.md).

Next steps I propose:
- If that looks good, Marcus (cc) will kick off a lightweight benchmark run the week of Apr 11 — we need a representative export (10–15k anonymized transcripts) and opt-in to the two-week trial credits.
- I’ll set up a shared Drive folder (link below) and HubSpot deal with acceptance gates recorded.

Please confirm and let us know any must-have metrics we missed. Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@greenstone-payments.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Greenstone discovery — next steps for eval

Thanks Hannah — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications before we commit the sample dataset: 

1) The acceptance thresholds look reasonable, but what does "parity" mean operationally? Do we need equivalence on all metrics at the same time, or is it OK to trade a small drop in extraction accuracy for faster latency?
2) Our compliance team will ask how you detect regressions in production. If an open model drifts over several weeks, what rollback cadence do you recommend?
3) Any rough estimate of credits/pricing for the two-week trial (we have to budget approvals).

We can prepare the anonymized transcripts but will need a DoA that confirms Redwood will not retain identifiable data beyond the agreed trial window.

—Maria
Director of Product, Greenstone Payments
maria.lopez@greenstone-payments.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@greenstone-payments.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Greenstone discovery — next steps for eval

On Mon, Apr 5, 2027 at 3:12 PM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood-inference.com> wrote:
> Hi Maria — great speaking with you today. Quick recap and proposed next steps...

Hi Maria — quick answers: 
1) Parity definition: we recommend a tiered gate approach rather than a single boolean. For launch-readiness we require that the open candidate meets: primary metric within 2–3% of PropBase-v1 AND no metric is worse by more than 5 percentage points. If latency improves >20% you can widen the extraction gate by 2 percentage points (tradeoff window). We call this the "parity band."

2) Regression detection & rollback: Redwood Optimize will compute rolling metric deltas by prompt-bundle and surface alerts. Recommended cadence: weekly automated re-eval on new sampled traffic + daily lightweight checks on hallucination probes. If a metric crosses the regression threshold (configurable, default 3 pp), traffic for the affected route automatically routes to PropBase-v1; we keep the open candidate in a canary for manual inspection. You can set an automated rollback window (e.g., immediate or 4-hour review).

3) Trial credits: for a two-week bench (10–15k transcripts + 50k tokens/day), estimate ~USD 1,800 in hosted credits (covers streaming tokens + eval harness). Dedicated/private deployments priced separately. I’ll have BD add formal numbers to the HubSpot deal but this is a ballpark for approvals.

Security/retention: We'll sign a short SCA/DoA for the trial window — Redwood does not retain unencrypted PII beyond the agreed retention period and we can enable a one-time post-trial purge of the sample set. Marcus (me) will own the purge run and provide logs.

Attachments referenced: redwood_eval_playbook.md (eval steps & metrics), greenstone_benchmark_template.xlsx (upload template).

Happy to run a demo of the regression dashboard if helpful.

—Marcus
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T10:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Greenstone discovery — next steps for eval

Thanks — great questions, Maria. Confirming next steps and owners: 

- Greenstone: prepare anonymized export (10–15k transcripts) and upload to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-greenstone-eval by Apr 9. (If you need a secure SFTP instead we can provide.) — Owner: Maria
- Redwood: spin up benchmark run (Llama3-8B-ql, Falcon-40B-instruct, Mistral-instruct-7B + PropBase-v1) and run acceptance gates over 7 days, enable canary + rollback policy. — Owner: Marcus
- Legal/Compliance: exchange trial DoA/SCA. We will provide a one-time purge log post-trial. — Owner: Priyom
- Budget: we estimate USD ~1.8k in hosted credits for the core run. BD will confirm.

Acceptance criteria recap (short):
- Primary: summary ROUGE-1 F1 >= 0.88 relative to PropBase-v1 (within parity band)
- Extraction: token-F1 >= 0.92
- Hallucination <3%
- p95 latency <350ms
- Regression threshold: 3 percentage points

Proposed kickoff: Apr 11 (Marcus to start the bench) — I'll send a calendar invite after you confirm the upload method.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Hannah
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood-inference.com
